Hi Sanjay / Emily —

Thanks again for the time on the call this morning — really appreciated the context on Sunrise Health's priorities (Reduce inference cost for patient summaries, maintain sub-300ms p95 for patient-facing workflows, and meet SOC 2 controls). Per our discussion I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to help align milestones, owners, and a couple timeline options so we can pick a cadence that works for you.

High-level goals we heard:
- Cost reduction target: 30% token-cost reduction for the summarization pipeline
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 300ms for patient-facing endpoints
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II evidence and network isolation for PHI

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) Discovery & data access (owner: Sunrise IT) — provide sample dataset + access window
2) Architecture review & security questionnaire (owner: Redwood SE + Sunrise Security) — complete questionnaire + evidence
3) Pilot (POC) deployment & validation (owner: Redwood SE + Sunrise Dev) — 3-week pilot, success metrics validated
4) Pricing & terms (owner: Sunrise Procurement + Redwood Sales) — finalize contract redlines
5) Production rollout & post-launch monitoring (owner: Sunrise Platform + Redwood CSM)

Dependencies:
- Completed security questionnaire (SOC 2 artifacts)
- Test dataset and non-production network access for the POC
- Procurement timelines / legal review window

Timeline options (pick one):
- Option A — Aggressive: 6 weeks to target close (Target signature: 2026-12-23). Useful if Procurement/legal can prioritize before the holiday pause.
- Option B — Conservative: 10 weeks to target close (Target signature: 2027-01-20). Allows for year-end freezes and formal legal scheduling.

I've attached the initial MAP draft (Redwood_MAP_Draft_Sunrise_v1.pdf) for your review. Can you confirm the following so we can schedule a MAP kickoff meeting next week?
- Preferred timeline (Option A or B)
- Primary stakeholders we should include on the kickoff (security, procurement, platform owner)
- Any additional dependencies we missed

Proposed 30–45min kickoff windows (all times PT):
- Tue 11/17 10:00–10:45
- Wed 11/18 14:00–14:45
- Thu 11/19 09:30–10:15

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on next steps.

Best,
